what: The 50-frame dev slice: which frames of the 390 GB corpus make up the fast-iteration day.
why: The slice existed only as whatever happened to be in D:\DCIM\100CANON. One delete and its definition was gone, and it is not reconstructible by guessing -- evenly spaced is a rule, but the exact indices are not derivable from it.
source_corpus: cr3-day-390GB, 2024-10-02 San Juan Mtns, R5 serial 082021001047, 7,395 frames
selection: Evenly spaced across the whole shooting day, NOT contiguous -- a contiguous block would sit inside one stretch of good track and never exercise the 'in a gap too wide to bridge' branch.
restore: Copy these 50 from the corpus into <card>\DCIM\100CANON on BOTH cards. Decision 27 refuses a run unless the two cards present the same listing.
